authorship: Independent fixture expectations written before reading Root's kernel implementation.

contract.delta_policy: wide exact addition; overflow, bound violation or collision with invalid sentinel leave original unchanged

contract.role_policy: exclude original humans even during autoplay; conservative first-prototype current-human exclusion too
contract.status_reason_note: Reason names are semantic categories; implementation may map names explicitly. Do not call a missing guard passed merely because only score equality was checked.
contract.bounds_note: Fixture limits are synthetic contract parameters, not calibrated release weights.
contract.snapshot_note: Policy version is bound to one immutable analysis snapshot. Root selected publication only while frozen and quiescent; attempted mid-analysis publication is rejected, not partially accepted.

limits: All data are synthetic acceptance expectations; this pack does not claim tests passed.
Root's actual ABI/kernel harness must map these independent semantic fields and report unsupported cases explicitly.
Zero-preserve policy omits legal zero opportunities; valid negative results are not blanket-rejected.
Exact no-op value/memory tests cannot establish in-game interception neutrality or performance.
No game, FireTuner, Frida, hook, native process or extension implementation was run/read by the fixture author.

admission_cases.qualification: Admission potential does not grant ownership, treasury funding, successful reservation or immediate CanZone.
